name: vendor-rivian-client-parallax
_authored: Hand-authored deliberately. Do NOT regenerate from the plan: PRD refinement is a judgement step, and the judgement being protected (never attempt mode:human stories) is prose in the same document a generator would read. Artifacts live in home-assistant-rivian/ (the surviving repo) so they are version-controlled; the workspace root is not a git repo. Only .omc-workspace stays at the root, since it must anchor state across both repos.

_loop.rule: Work the first story with passes:false whose deps are all passes:true. Run its gate. Set passes:true ONLY on exit 0. Append findings to progress.txt. Never attempt a story with mode:human — stop and report instead.

_guardrails: Stay on branch vendor-client in BOTH repos; assert every iteration. pre-release.yaml fires on dev and dev-* and publishes a zip beta users install.
No git push, no --force, no tags. A tag matching v?*.*.* on rivian-python-client publishes to PyPI.
No writing gh commands (gh release, gh workflow run, gh pr merge, gh api -X POST|PATCH|PUT|DELETE). workflow_dispatch is enabled on both pre-release workflows.
The 'on:' block of every workflow is immutable. S12b may edit 'jobs:' only.
Never emit a secret VALUE into any file, commit, log, progress.txt or prd.json. The .storage corrupt-backup deletion and the .env move are human steps.
Do not delete or skip tests to pass a gate. Exactly two deletions are sanctioned: S6a deletes test_decode_unknown_rvm_returns_raw; S9a deletes the removed-entity tests.
Never lower --cov-fail-under. It ratchets one way.
Never resolve a merge conflict with -X ours / -X theirs wholesale.

_environment.python: uv python install 3.13 -> cpython-3.13.13 (HA 2025.10.4 requires >=3.13.2). Homebrew python@3.13 is gone; brew now ships 3.14 only.
_environment.rebuild: uv venv --python 3.13 venv && VIRTUAL_ENV=$PWD/venv uv pip install -r requirements_test.txt
_environment.extra_pins: uv pip install 'pycares<5' 'habluetooth==5.6.4' 'bleak-retry-connector==4.4.3' 'dbus-fast==2.44.3' -- uv pip does NOT apply HA's package_constraints.txt, so pycares resolved past the aiodns 3.5.0 API and habluetooth past bleak 1.0.1.
_environment.ha_version: test env resolves HA 2025.10.4, pinned by pytest-homeassistant-custom-component -- NOT the 2025.12.0 the plan's dependency section cites. Conclusions verified to hold on both.
_environment.grep: ugrep 7.5.0, not GNU grep. Inside grep -E, \| is a literal pipe. Gates are bash, not zsh.
_environment.omc_workspace: .omc-workspace marker present at the workspace root so both repos share one PRD.

stories.title: Record the real coverage baseline
stories.detail: The committed .coverage/htmlcov are from a nine-file subset run and disagree with each other; neither is quotable. Run the full suite once in a fresh venv, record global and per-file percentages to docs/COVERAGE_BASELINE.md, and set --cov-fail-under in pytest.ini to the measured floor so the ratchet starts from truth. Target remains 80% by S11.

stories.title: Fix the 10 order-dependent test failures
stories.detail: The suite is NOT green: 10 failures that all pass in isolation. Five test modules permanently replace the client in sys.modules at IMPORT time with no teardown (test_button.py:19-21,30-31; test_select.py:23; test_update.py:20-21; test_coordinator_base.py:25; test_lock.py:15). Collection is alphabetical, so test_update's bare Mock() clobbers test_coordinator_base's carefully-built one and pytest.raises() receives a Mock. Replace the module-level assignments with fixture-scoped patch.dict(sys.modules, ...) that tears down. MUST land before S7: after vendoring, imports become custom_components.rivian.rivian_client and sys.modules['rivian'] stops intercepting anything, so these stubs fail silently. Also required for any gate to be trustworthy -- order-dependent failures make the loop thrash or record false passes.

stories.title: Get CI onto the vendor-client branch
stories.detail: rivian-python-client/.github/workflows/ci.yaml EXISTS (ruff, mypy, pytest on 3.9-3.13) but triggers on main only — extend its trigger to vendor-client and add coverage. home-assistant-rivian has no test workflow at all; create one. Principle 4: CI exists before the risky work.

stories.title: HUMAN: merge client onto upstream 2.1.0 transport
stories.detail: Adopt upstream's plain-string GraphQL transport and ClientResponse shape; drop gql. parallax.py is add/add with ZERO common ancestry (ours 22218 bytes, theirs 21668) — resolve by taking upstream's file as the base and appending our builder half. rivian.py: port only the ~20 methods with a reachable caller, delete the ~45 without one. Judgement call — do not automate. USER OVERRIDE (explicit): originally mode:human; the user directed the loop to attempt it autonomously with review after. Risk accepted and recorded: the merge has no test oracle — the suites are part of what is merged, so `git merge -X ours` satisfies 'no conflict markers + pytest green'. The preserved-symbol manifest in scripts/gates/s03.sh is the only real check.

stories.title: Client cleanup
stories.detail: Drop py<3.11 shims (stdlib StrEnum, asyncio.timeout); bump requires-python to >=3.10; give bleak an honest ceiling; fix set_climate_hold (validates temp_celsius then never sends it); correct the ten '32-byte' phone_id docstrings — the correct value is 16-byte uuid.UUID(vasPhoneId).bytes. Do NOT fix the four setters S9a deletes.

stories.title: Merge upstream 1.5.3b5 into the integration (all 19 conflicts)
stories.detail: User decision: the loop attempts all 19 conflicted files. Take upstream wholesale for the Parallax routing, the charging fixes, INITIAL_UPDATE_TIMEOUT=60, the vehicleMileage oscillation guard, gnssLocation resilience, and time.py + Platform.TIME. Keep ours for notify.py, next_action_states.py, services.yaml, the i18n conversion and the entity renaming. Adopt upstream's ClientResponse shape. Record the strings.json decision rather than inventing one. Version must be 1.5.4-beta1, never 0.0.0.

stories.title: Route Parallax through the real decoders; unify get()
stories.detail: Delete _decode_payload (the {"raw": ...} stub) and its test test_decode_unknown_rvm_returns_raw — deleted, not adapted. Route to decode_parallax_message. Subscribe with an explicit DEDUPED PARALLAX_RVMS + CHARGING_RVMS list (they overlap), not rvms=None. Collapse the three conflicting get() signatures onto the base 2-arg dot-notation form.

stories.title: De-duplicate the watchdog; extend diagnostics
stories.detail: The 502/504 + watchdog block is copy-pasted three times (~90 lines each). Write contract tests against the intended behaviour FIRST, then lift it into RivianDataUpdateCoordinator. Add Parallax data to diagnostics.py and extend redact()/TO_REDACT to the new fields.

stories.title: Vendor the client into custom_components/rivian/rivian_client/
stories.detail: One mechanical commit, done AFTER both merges so upstream's 12 files of top-level 'rivian' imports merge against matching lines rather than applying silently into renamed code. Rewrite every import to relative form. manifest.json: requirements [bleak>=0.21, protobuf>=6.31,<7] (protobuf is interim, S10 removes it), loggers [custom_components.rivian], iot_class cloud_push. Guard the BLE imports: button.py:11 under TYPE_CHECKING, button.py:14 lazy inside the press handler.

stories.title: HUMAN: capture RVM payload fixtures from the live vehicle
stories.detail: DONE 2026-08-18. Captured 3 of 4: climate_hold_status (8B), climate_hold_setting (3B, 08ac02 = 300s), vehicle_wheels (74B). CORRECTION: the previous premise -- that all four are 'verified-working QUERIES today, so the existing query path suffices' -- was FALSE. sendVehicleOperation selects only {success} (rivian.py:866-870); the payload arrives ONLY on the parallaxMessages subscription. Capture also requires SOLE-SUBSCRIBER access: the gateway permits one active subscription per user session, so the HA config entry must be disabled for the duration. ota.user_schedule.ota_config returned a 0-byte payload to an accepted signed GET across three sessions -- no schedule is configured -- and is DROPPED under principle 3. See docs/development/RVM_FIXTURES.md.

stories.title: Write and register the 4 missing decoders
stories.detail: Upstream's RVM_DECODERS covers 14 telemetry topics and NONE of the RVMs this plan ships. Write decode_* for the THREE captured RVMs only -- climate_hold_status, climate_hold_setting, vehicle_wheels -- register in RVM_DECODERS, and assert each against its s08a fixture. Do NOT write decode_ota_config: no fixture exists, its layout would be imagined, and the entity is dropped (s09a). See docs/development/RVM_FIXTURES.md.

stories.title: Prune unverified entities and builders
stories.detail: Remove PARALLAX_SWITCHES, PARALLAX_NUMBERS, PARALLAX_SELECTS, the parallax.* prefix routing and the rivian.set_geofences service — all target RVMs that return INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR. Delete their translation/icon keys and their tests. Then prune parallax.py from 21 build_* functions to the 4 backing verified RVMs, and prune RVMType to match. Incidentally fixes select.py:203's KeyError.

stories.title: Wire the 4 survivors onto decoded data
stories.detail: Move cabin_climate_hold off VehicleCommand.CLIMATE_HOLD_ON/OFF onto the Parallax climate_hold_setting write — the ONE verified write — reading climate_hold_status. Add vehicle_wheels and ota_config as READ-ONLY attributes. ota_config is a Query, not a Command: do not build an OTA write, and do not route it through time.py, which is charging-only.

stories.title: Remove protobuf
stories.detail: Ten top-level google.protobuf sites: parallax.py:13, proto/vehicle_operation.py:6-7, proto/ota.py:5, and proto/{base,charging,climate,energy,navigation,security,vehicle}.py:6. They subclass _message.Message at RUNTIME so TYPE_CHECKING does not help, and proto/__init__.py imports eight of them so fixing a subset still ImportErrors on every send_vehicle_operation. DELETE proto/climate.py — the shipped write imports rivian_climate_pb2.ClimateHoldSetting; proto/climate.py holds a dead incompatible definition. Keep and rewrite proto/vehicle_operation.py. Capture golden bytes from _pb2 BEFORE deleting. Then drop protobuf from manifest requirements.

stories.title: Close the coverage gap to 80%
stories.detail: Global 80% AND coordinator.py plus each platform file at 80% independently. pytest-cov's --cov-fail-under is global-only, so per-file uses coverage json + a script. No added skip/xfail/pragma.

stories.title: Devcontainer boots real HA
stories.detail: Install requirements_test.txt, symlink custom_components/rivian into the container HA config dir, pin the HA version (requirements says >=2025.1.0, config/.HA_VERSION is 2025.10.4, the venv has 2025.12.0 — a .storage seeded by a newer HA is unreadable by an older one). Add scripts/seed_config_entry.py reading tokens from env at runtime, never inlining a value.

stories.title: Release hardening and the remaining CI gates
stories.detail: Switch BOTH release.yaml:26-28 and pre-release.yaml:70-72 to a zip allowlist; pre-release fires on every dev push and matters more. Anchor release.yaml:22's sed to "version": — it currently rewrites every line containing 'version'. Add the artifact secret-scan and the load test (unzip into a bare HA container with only the declared requirements, start HA, fail if it does not load). Edit 'jobs:' only, never 'on:'.

stories.title: HUMAN: end-to-end against the real vehicle
stories.detail: The seven thresholds in the plan's Verification 6. Requires the real vehicle and live credentials — final acceptance, not automatable.

stories.title: Document upstream tracking
stories.detail: Record in CLAUDE.md that custom_components/rivian/rivian_client/ is the vendored client, edited in place, with no external package to bump. Rehearse an upstream merge as a DRY RUN: git merge --no-commit --no-ff upstream/main, capture output and conflicted paths to docs/UPSTREAM_MERGE_REHEARSAL.md, then git merge --abort. A real rehearsed merge would be a fifth human gate.

_baseline.note: 22% was a nine-file subset run. Baseline 75% at s01 -> 76% after s01b -> 78.86% after partial s11. Floor 78 (79 fails: true value 78.86).
